name: Radico Khaitan Limited
summary: Radico Khaitan Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL), country liquor, and other alcoholic products in India, Ghana, Nigeria, Sudan, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. The company provides IMFL products in various categories of whisky, vodka, rum, gin, brandy, and liqueurs, as well as ethanol. It also provides bottling services to other spirit manufacturers.
